name: Condition Not Listed

category.name: General
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: Most recent detailed Clinical Progress Note(s)
Results of recent testing already performed pertinent to the condition

rows.label: A
rows.condition: AME determines the individual is NOT at increased risk for sudden or subtle incapacitation.
rows.condition_html:
A. AME determines the individual is

NOT at increased risk

for sudden or subtle incapacitation.
rows.evaluation_data: When a diagnosis or condition is not listed in the disposition tables, the AME should assess whether the condition or its treatment could lead to sudden or subtle incapacitation. After reviewing the condition and submitted reports, document the rationale for issuance in Item 60 and upload supporting documentation. The FAA may request additional evaluation data. If uncertain, the AME may wish to contact AMCD or RFS and discuss.
rows.evaluation_data_html:
When a diagnosis or condition is not listed in the disposition tables, the AME should assess whether the condition or its treatment could lead to sudden or subtle incapacitation.

After reviewing the condition and submitted reports, document the rationale for issuance in Item 60 and upload supporting documentation. The FAA may request additional evaluation data.

If uncertain, the AME may wish to contact AMCD or RFS and discuss.
rows.disposition: ISSUE and explain rationale in Item 60.

rows.label: B
rows.condition: AME determines the individual IS at increased risk for sudden or subtle incapacitation.
rows.condition_html:
B. AME determines the individual

IS at increased risk

for sudden or subtle incapacitation.
rows.evaluation_data: Medical certificates must not be issued to an individual with medical condition(s) that requires deferral, or for any condition not listed in the table that may result in sudden or subtle incapacitation without consulting the AMCD or the RFS. To help expedite the review process, submit the following to the FAA for review: - Most recent detailed Clinical Progress Note(s) - Results of recent testing already performed pertinent to the condition - Any related treatment records After reviewing this documentation, the FAA may request additional evaluation data.
rows.evaluation_data_html:
Medical certificates must not be issued to an individual with medical condition(s) that requires deferral, or for any condition not listed in the table that may result in sudden or subtle incapacitation without consulting the AMCD or the RFS.

To help expedite the review process, submit the following to the FAA for review:

  • Most recent detailed Clinical Progress Note(s)
  • Results of recent testing already performed pertinent to the condition
  • Any related treatment records

After reviewing this documentation, the FAA may request additional evaluation data.
what_to_bring: Most recent detailed Clinical Progress Note(s)
